tests: operations: twenty concurrent retries acquire one durable dispatch
acceptance.observed: Exactly one of 20 concurrent accept/acquire sequences receives a commit-backed dispatch grant; all observe the same dispatching record.

tests: operations: content conflicts and revoked context never retarget a prepared intent
operations: identity alone grants no authority and SOS has global scope
acceptance.observed: Different immutable content conflicts, changed credential/grant/config rejects unstarted records, and unrelated/unauthorized principals cannot read or execute.

tests: operations: abrupt process death before and after adapter send never causes replay
operations: recovery invalidates prepared and accepted without acquiring dispatch
operations: a newer authority boot fences an older open connection
operations: late authenticated actuator acknowledgement resolves unknown without resend
operations: transaction failure never returns a dispatch grant
operations: disk full during real WAL commit grants no dispatch and preserves accepted record
acceptance.observed: File-backed SQLite/WAL survives abrupt process exit before/after a file-marker send; uncertain state recovers unknown with no second grant. Commit failure gives no grant.

tests: operations: expiry retention and removal cannot resurrect old identities
acceptance.observed: 30-second expiry and 24-hour retention enforced; removed/unknown handles never create operations, and malformed IDs fail validation.

tests: operations: prepared capacity and pagination remain bounded
operations: unresolved records fill active capacity and are never silently evicted
operations: all-state reservation ceiling preserves young terminal results
operations: bounded metadata and results retain existing reservations
operations: disk full during real WAL commit grants no dispatch and preserves accepted record
acceptance.observed: Real SQLite admission reaches 128 prepared, 2048 active/unknown and 4096 total limits; unknown/young terminals retained, page limit32, record byte reservations bounded, real VFS SQLITE_FULL fails closed.

limitations: No pre-existing ledger API: no fabricated compile-failure RED.
Store production layer; Node/HTTP/mesh/ABI operation integration and current door/action permission evaluation belong to T06.
No hardware actuator, SOS delivery, hardware power-loss or device qualification.
ASan covers C/C++ Core and SQLite; no general LeakSanitizer claim.
128/2048/4096 capacity tests use real in-memory SQLite; WAL/process-death/full-write tests use actual file databases. 48 MiB is logical reservation only.
cleanup: New operation fixtures, WAL/SHM/marker files and child processes cleaned. Existing Store regression scratch directories and dedicated evidence/build/binaries retained; no device or service deployment.
